cases.name: recovery-replay-none-single-attempt

recovery policy once:
    attempts 1
    deadline 100000ms
    replay none

return match r {Ok(v)=>0,Err(f)=>match f {Error(e)=>7,Exhausted(n,e)=>n,Uncertain(op,n,e)=>n}}

negative.name: unknown-policy
negative.source:
module RecoveryNegative
intent "negative"
faults unwind
type IoError=Timeout|Unavailable
recovery policy p:
    attempts 1
    deadline 1000ms
    retry on Timeout
    replay safe
fn work()->Result<int, IoError> recovers nope { return Ok(1) }
fn main()->int { return 0 }

negative.name: recursive
negative.source:

intent "negative"
faults unwind

recovery policy p:
    attempts 1
    deadline 1000ms
    retry on Timeout
    replay safe

fn main()->int { return 0 }
